segments.title: Find what needs you
segments.narration: With where-der, you can see which tasks need you, without checking every agent.

segments.title: Open the Board
segments.narration: Open the Board. Tasks are grouped by what happens next: Needs you, Ready to approve, Working, and To do.

segments.title: Start with Needs you
segments.narration: Start with Needs you. This task is waiting for a decision, so it is the first place to look.

segments.title: Open the task
segments.narration: Select the task to open its details. Read the description and the question, with the task status still in view.

segments.title: Keep the context
segments.narration: The Task tab keeps the context together: the latest summary, the review, and the pull request, when available.

segments.title: Check progress
segments.narration: Back on the Board, Working shows progress at a glance. Open a task whenever you need the full context.

segments.title: Focus on the next step
segments.narration: Find what needs you, understand the next step, and let the rest keep moving.
